summary: Defines a SiteDocument entity with SiteID and ID. Used to represent documents related to a site.
purpose: To provide strongly-typed access to site document information within the HSPnet data layer.
content_gaps: No information on workflows, usage context, or business rules.

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin is a UI module for staff administrators. It manages display and interaction for viewing submitted employment applications, handling warning/error panels, and filtering/searching by site, discipline, date range, and withdrawn status.
purpose: To provide an interactive dashboard for staff admins to review employment applications, manage errors/warnings, and filter/search applications.

actors.name: StaffAdmin
actors.role: Views/applications, manages warnings/errors, searches/applications, filters by withdrawn status

workflows.name: Review Employment Applications
steps: Display filter panel with site, discipline, date range, withdrawn checkbox.
User sets filters and clicks refresh.
Grid binds and displays employment applications.
Row displays applicant name, contact, agency, program, site, submitted date, withdrawn status.
Warnings and errors shown in panels with option to hide.

business_rules: StartDate and EndDate are required and validated.
StartDate must not be after EndDate (validated by client function checkStartEnd).
Withdrawn applications can be included/excluded via checkbox.
Filters by site and discipline are available. 'All' options inserted for both.
validations: RegularExpressionValidator for date format on both StartDate and EndDate.
conditions: If StartDate > EndDate, form is invalid.
If WithdrawnDate is null, status is 'Submitted'. Otherwise display 'Withdrawn' and show WithdrawnDate.
system_behavior: On first page load, defaults date range to last 3 months.
dependencies: UserSession for agency, timezone, login info.
content_gaps: No explicit exception handling, only UI and workflow behavior covered.

summary: ServiceCode entity represents a code and its associated metadata, used for service categorization in courses and timetables.
purpose: To provide listing and details of service codes, with support for alternate language fields depending on session settings.

workflows.name: List Service Codes
steps: Call ServiceCodeListAll procedure for all codes.
Localize fields based on session language preference.

business_rules: If session uses alternate language fields, Name and Notes are replaced with NameAlt and NotesAlt.
conditions: Session may dictate alternate language field usage.
system_behavior: ServiceCode entities are instantiated and populated from SQL data readers.
Supports listing by course or timetable.
content_gaps: No UI, actor information or explicit validation/exception handling.

summary: SiteProfileHistory tracks changes to site profiles, including actions, fields affected, user and agency information, and phone number. Includes alternate language support and custom formatting.
purpose: To maintain an audit trail of site profile updates for accountability and support.

workflows.name: Site Profile Change Audit
steps: User triggers update to site profile.
Audit record created with action, fields, user/agency information.
Optional: alternate language fields used if session requires.

business_rules: Displays formatted dates and user details.
Formatting adapts to alternate language as configured.
conditions: If session uses alternate language fields, display ScreenSectionAlt, UserActionAlt, FieldsAlt.
system_behavior: Audit records populated via FillList from database.
Tooltip methods generate user/agency formatted details.
UserControl manages session/agency context for searching history.
dependencies: Session settings, phone formatting, NameFormatter, DateFormatter.
content_gaps: No explicit exception handling, incomplete details on all audit fields.

summary: EmailPopupDocument represents a file shown in an email popup UI, including handling file deletion and searching by information string.
purpose: To manage email-related document files for popups, including search, display, and deletion of files.

workflows.name: Search and Display Email Popup Documents
steps: Parse DataInfo string with file info separated by '|'.
Split each entry by '>' to get filename and filepath.
Create EmailPopupDocument entity for display in UI.

workflows.name: Delete Email Popup Document
steps: Return new DataInfo string omitting deleted entry.

business_rules: If DataInfo is empty, no documents are processed.
system_behavior: Handles file deletion safely with try/catch.
Search returns list of EmailPopupDocument entities.
dependencies: File and Directory classes for deletion. DataInfo string.
exceptions: File deletion is wrapped in try/catch to avoid breaking flow.
content_gaps: No information about UI display, actor roles, or additional business rules.
